An Android browser written in Kotlin (personal project): ad blocking, privacy protection, page translation, MCP service and network capture. Native XML + View UI, no user data collection.

Open source projects used by Sii:

Kotlin Standard Library, Kotlin Coroutines (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX Core, AppCompat, Fragment, Lifecycle, Activity (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX DataStore Preferences (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX Room Runtime / KTX / Compiler (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX Browser (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX DocumentFile (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX Biometric (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX CameraX Core / Camera2 / Lifecycle / View (Apache-2.0)
AndroidX Media3 (ExoPlayer / HLS / UI) (Apache-2.0)
ZXing Core (Apache-2.0)
OkHttp, Okio (Apache-2.0)

See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md in the repository for the full list and copyright notices. Update that list and this page when adding dependencies.

It uses a non-commercial license: no commercial use, attribution required, derivatives must follow the same terms. See LICENSE for details.
